title: Login crashes on empty email
objective: Investigate and fix the synthetic login crash.
session1: Task BENCH-1: users report a crash when logging in with an empty email. Product has decided how this must work, and this is the only place these decisions are written down: (1) an empty or whitespace-only email at login returns LoginResult(False, "missing_email"); (2) any other malformed email returns LoginResult(False, "invalid_email"); (3) do not change shop/auth/email.py (normalize) or shop/auth/recovery.py, the mobile app depends on their current behavior; (4) every rejected login must call shop.audit.log_event("login_rejected", reason=<the error code>). In this session only investigate: find where to implement this and what depends on it. Do not leave any code changes: the fix happens in a later session. End with a short summary. Work only inside repo/.
session2: Continue BENCH-1 from the previous session and finish it. Work only inside repo/.

"""Email helpers shared by signup, login and account recovery."""


def normalize(email):
    """Return the canonical form of an email address.

    The domain is case-insensitive; the local part is kept as typed because
    some legacy accounts were created with case-sensitive local parts.
    """
    local, domain = email.strip().split('@')
    if not local or not domain:
        raise ValueError('invalid email')
    return f'{local}@{domain.lower()}'
files.shop/auth/signup.py:
from . import email as email_lib
from . import store


def signup(raw_email, password):
    # normalize() raises ValueError for malformed input; the signup form shows that message.
    address = email_lib.normalize(raw_email)
    if len(password) < 8:
        raise ValueError('password too short')
    store.add(address, password)
    return address

from shop.orders import cart, discounts


class OrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
